near_miss_note: During this run, a note page for an already-published Nov 3 Willison article ('qwen-can-interpret-model-weights', published 2026-11-04) was initially rewritten with new wording before being caught via git status/diff and reverted; the corresponding daily-JSON entry was removed and state.json's two timestamps for it were restored to their original 2026-11-04 value (they had briefly been overwritten to today's date). No incorrect data was committed. Flagging this so a future run double-checks seen_urls against the FULL unsorted/untruncated list, not a sorted-and-truncated view, before treating a note-page path as new.
environment_note: Same pattern as prior recent runs: only anthropic.com (incl. code.claude.com), github.com, and generativelanguage.googleapis.com are directly reachable from this sandbox; every other configured source domain (openai.com, blog.google, ai.meta.com, x.ai, mistral.ai, api-docs.deepseek.com, news.smol.ai, tldr.tech, simonwillison.net, latent.space, oneusefulthing.org, youtube.com, hn.algolia.com, news.ycombinator.com) fails DNS resolution or has its CONNECT tunnel refused by the egress proxy. WebSearch remained the only reliable discovery channel for everything outside the three reachable domains, with the Willison github-mirror as the one workaround that recovers full article text instead of just search snippets. This continues to produce an unusually thin news day for non-Anthropic vendors and makes video coverage impossible to verify — should keep being flagged as environment degradation, not a quiet news day.
